content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD tridiagonal solvers (BSD header L1-44; filename spelled 'tridiagnal'). Five subroutines. (1) TRIDy_periodic(a,c,d,f) (L59-325, Kirby 03/07/2014, Shi 02/29/2016) solves the periodic quasi-tridiagonal system in y via the Sherman-Morrison algorithm per Thomas 1995 Numerical PDEs Sec 5.6.1 (comment L49-52). Off-diagonal corner values are stored in a(i,Jbeg) and c(i,Jend) (comment L86). Steps: collect corner vectors A_beg(I)=a(I,Jbeg), C_end(I)=c(I,Jend) — under PARALLEL with PY>1 exchanged between south row ProcessorID(II,1) and north row ProcessorID(II,PY) via MPI_SEND/MPI_IRECV+MPI_WAITALL per processor column II=1..PX (L94-141); serial/PY=1 direct copy (L136-140, L145-148). Renormalize first/last rows: c(i,Jbeg)=c(i,Jbeg)/(1+c_end(I)), d likewise (L155-156/L169-170) and a(i,Jend)=a(i,Jend)/(1+a_beg(I)), d likewise (L161-162/L171-172). Save c1=c (L180; comment L177-178 'c and d will get trashed'), pass one solves B y1=d via TRIDy (PARALLEL, L185) or TRIDy_ser (L187). Build second RHS w: d zeroed (L195-199), d(i,Jbeg)=1.0_SP/(1.0_SP+c_end(I)) (L204/L216), d(i,Jend)=-1.0_SP/(1.0_SP+a_beg(I)) (L210/L220); pass two solves B y2=w (L229/L231). Scale factor beta(i)=(c_end(I)*y1(i,Jbeg)-a_beg(I)*y1_end(I))/(1.0_SP-(c_end(I)*y2(i,Jbeg)-a_beg(I)*y2_end(I))) computed on south row after gathering y1(:,Jend),y2(:,Jend) from north row (L241-283), broadcast down each processor column via MPI_SEND to ProcessorID(II,l), l=2..PY (L285-297); serial forms use y1(i,Jend)/y2(i,Jend) directly (L305-306, L313-314). Final combination f(i,j)=y1(i,j)+beta(i)*y2(i,j) (L319). (2) TRIDy_ser(A,C,D,Z) (L338-361, ifndef PARALLEL): Thomas algorithm in y, in-place forward sweep C(II,JJ)=C(II,JJ)/A(II,JJ)/(1.0_SP/A(II,JJ)-C(II,JJ-1)) and D(II,JJ)=(D(II,JJ)/A(II,JJ)-D(II,JJ-1))/(1.0_SP/A(II,JJ)-C(II,JJ-1)) for JJ=Jbeg+1..Jend guarded by A.NE.ZERO (L347-352), then back substitution Z(II,Jend)=D(II,Jend) (L354), Z(II,JJ)=D(II,JJ)-C(II,JJ)*Z(II,JJ+1) downward (L356-358). (3) TRIDx_ser(A,C,D,Z) (L375-398, ifndef PARALLEL): same Thomas algorithm along x (II=Ibeg+1..Iend sweep L385-389, back-sub Z(Iend,JJ)=D(Iend,JJ) L391, Z(II,JJ)=D(II,JJ)-C(II,JJ)*Z(II+1,JJ) L393-395). (4) TRIDx(a,c,d,f) (L413-488, PARALLEL, Jeff Harris 02/14/2010, Shi 05/01/2011): pipelined parallel Thomas in x — if n_west is a neighbor, receive rmsg(j,1)=d,rmsg(j,2)=c of the west boundary and renormalize local first column c(Ibeg,j),d(Ibeg,j) (L425-435); interior in-place sweep (L437-446); send smsg(j,1)=d(Iend,j),smsg(j,2)=c(Iend,j) east (L448-456); back substitution: receive f from east (f(Iend,j)=d(Iend,j)-c(Iend,j)*rmsg(j,1), L460-466) or set f(Iend,j)=d(Iend,j) at domain edge (L468-470), sweep f(i,j)=d(i,j)-c(i,j)*f(i+1,j) (L473-476), send f(Ibeg,j) west (L478-486). (5) TRIDy(a,c,d,f) (L502-578, PARALLEL): identical scheme along y using n_suth/n_nrth neighbors and Mloc-sized messages (forward L513-546, back substitution L550-576). All MPI messages use tag 0 for forward and tag 1 for backward passes over communicator comm2d in TRIDx/TRIDy, MPI_COMM_WORLD in TRIDy_periodic.

!      Thomas, J. W., 1995, Numerical Partial Differential Equations, Springer,
!  off diagonal corner values are stored in a(i,Jbeg) and c(i, Jend)
!  Diagonal matrix now stored in a,c.  c and d will get trashed in first call to TRIDy.
!    TRIDx is parallel version of the subroutine to

unresolved: TRIDy_periodic locals Axx,Cxx,Dxx,U1D declared @L82 and rmsg,smsg @L83 are never used in its body (L88-324); PARALLEL locals nreq,ll,myvar,mybeta @L72,@L76 also unused

loop index variables i,j in TRIDy_periodic/TRIDx/TRIDy are not declared locally (only II,JJ @L72; commented 'integer i, j' @L511) — presumably USE GLOBAL I,J via USE PARAM/GLOBAL; cannot be confirmed from this file
case-insensitive reuse: A_beg/C_end written @L146-147 are the same variables as a_beg/c_end declared @L81 (Fortran case-insensitivity)

in the corner-collection loops the inner index is lowercase i (do i = 1,Mloc @L103) but the renormalization loops use c_end(I)/a_beg(I) with the loop variable spelled i (do i= Ibeg, Iend @L154, c_end(I) @L155) — same identifier; anchors verified per line
header comment of TRIDy @L496 says 'TRIDx is parallel version' while the routine solves the y direction (@L497, SUBROUTINE TRIDy @L502) — copy-paste artifact

serial second-RHS loop @L215-221 zeroes only interior j=Jbeg+1..Jend-1 @L217-219 while the PARALLEL branch zeroes all interior cells first @L195-199 then sets ends @L201-213; equivalence depends on d having no stale values outside Jbeg..Jend rows — relation across L195-221

TRIDy_periodic under PARALLEL requires PY processor rows with ProcessorID mapping; the beta broadcast loops @L285-297 execute MPI_SEND/IRECV pairs inside DO II=1,PX with all ranks iterating — correctness relies on matched send/recv ordering across ranks, not verifiable from this file alone

TRIDx/TRIDy forward sweeps are guarded by a(i,j).ne.ZERO (@L440,@L530) but boundary renormalization divides by a(Ibeg,j)/a(i,Jbeg) only inside the same guard (@L430,@L520); rows with a=0 skip renormalization entirely — semantic assumption that a=0 marks masked rows, defined elsewhere
